title: Quote node --test globs in npm scripts
body:
Wrap each glob in escaped double quotes in package.json so node --test expands it itself. Unquoted, sh on Linux and macOS expands ** without globstar as a single level and silently skips nested test files, while Windows passes the pattern through and runs them all.

Why: On 2026-09-22 the same suite ran 323 tests on Windows and 245 on Linux with no error; quoting the globs brought Linux to the full count.

v1.trigger: when adding or editing an npm script that passes glob patterns such as tests/**/*.test.js
